text_block_list.text:
—The new year has begun. Late last year, Biko Pegasus
became the new sprint hero, but...

As expected, the center of attention was the Arima Kinen.
Among everyone, Narita Brian drew overwhelming focus as the undisputed strongest contender.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian-san,
you had a spectacular year last year, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us straight up what your goals are for this spring?
Are you planning to go from the Tenno Sho (Spring) to the Takarazuka Kinen, after all?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Tepid.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Wait, lukewarm...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Every GⅠ I can run in—I'll run in all of them.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, "everything"... you really mean all of it!?
Brian-san, wait a second!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, every single GⅠ we can enter, huh?
You're incredible, Trainer.
Together with Biko Pegasus, I watched the chaotic press conference unfold on TV.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But why would Brian-san push herself that recklessly?
Could it be just like the rumors say...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Are you irritated because we couldn't have
our big sister showdown last year?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that might be true too...
Yeah, that might be part of it too...

text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's older sister is Biwa Hayahide.
A tactical genius who pursues her winning formula, she is one of the strongest active Umamusume.

Narita Brian had aimed for a showdown between sisters,
but Biwa Hayahide's injury last autumn
kept it from happening.

It's only speculation, but...
she might be trying to blow off that frustration by running race after race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even so, entering every single GⅠ...
Is it really okay to make such a wicked schedule?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Well, she'll be fine. Brian-san isn't so fragile that she needs me worrying about her!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, more importantly, let's go on our New Year's visit!
Those two are already waiting for us!

I had promised to go on today's Hatsumode
with two other people as well. Yes, those two are...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Happy New Yeeeear~~♪

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Happy New Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Happy New Year,
everyone!

Hishi Akebono and the stuntwoman.
Together with Biko Pegasus, they are all
challenging the barriers of their futures.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A lot happened to all of us last year.
Have you decided on your resolution for this year?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"My ambition is
'to become a hero who can save someone'!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
To put it simply, mine is "Claim my first victory!"♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ever since debuting in the fall, I'm still winless,
so first thing's first: getting that first win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Still, losing two in a row right off the bat means... maybe I shouldn't just keep charging blindly ahead like this."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm planning to take a break from racing until spring and focus on training.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, training is important, isn't it?
I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: My goal is... 'Pass on the next try!', I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Actually, the other day, I made it to the second round of auditions for a Hollywood movie!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?! Is making it to round two that big of a deal?!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Yes! The next one is the final round! Out of all the auditions I've taken, this is my biggest chance.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "If it lands here, it'll be a total turnaround! We might become stars overnight...!"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna polish
that Umamusume action of mine even further!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Running like this, going pitter-patter-dash...!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Owwie!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: !? Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, the muscle soreness in my back is...
But it's fine! Torn muscle fibers are just proof of growth!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Are you really okay~? Miss,
if you look closely, you're covered in bruises...!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal.
Umamusume action is intense, after all.
This is nothing.
choice_data_list: Please take good care of yourself. Your health is the foundation of everything.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Thank you for your concern.
I'll make sure to take every possible care from now on.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Just make sure you don't get hurt.
...And with that, the shrine visit came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Does anyone have plans after this?
If not, let's go hang out!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I agree! Where should we go?
I'm not too familiar with this area.
Trainer-san, do you know any good spots?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go all out and party,
but chilling out and chatting sounds great too~♪

What would be the most fun to do?
A good option might be...
choice_data_list: Let's go to an amusement park!
It's a New Year's karaoke showdown!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, now that you mention it, I am getting pretty hungry!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmm,
I can't decide which one to order~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Carrot loco moco looks delicious, but the portion is huge...!
Ah, carrot bagna cauda looks great too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's fiiiine~! Let's order a bunch of things and share~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why didn't I think of that!
You really are reliable, Bono~~!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's so nice to be able
to do things like this when we all come together.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've done something like this...
Takes me back to my school days...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What do you two want?
Let's order dessert too!

And so, a fun New Year's passed by.
It seems everyone was able to refresh
and fully recharge their batteries!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Amusement park! I'm going, I'm going!!
Let's ride the roller coaster!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Even though it's New Year's, it's so lively!
choice_data_list: Ah, there's a hero show going on!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Let's watch, let's watch!
Everyone, join in!
And so, we all took our seats. Today's hero's finishing move was—

text_block_list.name: Magnet Man
text_block_list.text:
Here I come, Giant Kaiju! With magnetic power,
Big Bang C-h-a-n-g-e!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oooh.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That giant hero was so cool!
Alright, I'm gonna try copying that move too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Biko-chan, give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here I come, Giant Bono!
Big Bang Biko!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? It hasn't changed much, has it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've changed, see~! Since I'm standing on tiptoes,
just a tiny bit! How's that~!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yeah, yeah!
It does make it look a little bigger.
Maybe I should try using that trick during photo shoots too.
Biko Pegasus stretched up on tiptoes with all her might. She felt like... she had grown just a little bit taller.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds like fun! It's pretty cold out,
so let's get fired up with some hot-blooded hero songs!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Go! Stand tall! Carrot~♪
Surging through my veins~ is love~ courage~ and ca~ro~tene~~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay, yay♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're a great singer, Miss!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I train my abs, after all.
My diaphragmatic breathing is on point too!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "You're great at it too, Biko-chan. As expected. Umamusume who run races also perform in lives, after all."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I practiced a ton so I could be a hero on stage, too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next up,
let's put on 'Wasshoi☆Carrotman Ondo'!

The duet with the older girl was brought to life by Hishi Akebono's enthusiastic call-and-response.
Everyone sang this and that together, having a wonderful time.
